lines.en: Can you show me the camera app?
Sure, Grandma. It's this picture of a camera.
I took a picture of the flowers this morning.
Wow, it's beautiful! Do you want to send it?
Yes. I will send it to your mom.
Okay. Open the message and put the picture here.
lines.ko: 네. 메시지를 열고 사진을 여기에 넣으세요.

lines.en: Is it sent? My phone is ringing now.
Yes! Mom is sending a message back now.
lines.ko: 네! 엄마가 지금 답장을 보내고 있어요.

lines.en: The battery is low. I will charge it later.
Good idea. Next time, let's make a video too.
Excuse me. Can you help me with an app?
lines.ko: 실례해요. 앱 하나 도와줄 수 있어요?

lines.en: Of course, Ma'am. Which app do you need?
The bus app. My grandson used it last week.
Okay. Please give me your phone for a minute.
Here it is. The battery is a little low.
That's fine. I will download it for you now.
Will it ring when the bus comes?
Yes, it will. It also sends you a message.
Thank you. Can you charge my phone here too?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 여기서 전화기 충전도 할 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure. Sit down, and I will bring you some tea.
